name: pappcorn-plugins
description: PappCorn's plugin catalog for Claude — free open-source connectors and skill packs, plus licensed plugins.

plugins.name: gmail-mcp
plugins.description: Read, search, triage, draft and SEND email from your own Gmail account. Uses your own Google OAuth app — your credentials never leave your machine.

plugins.name: gsheets-mcp
plugins.description: Inspect, search and EDIT Google Sheets that were shared with you — in place, without loading the file into the context. Every write is previewed and confirmed. Uses your own Google OAuth app.

plugins.name: whatsapp-mcp
plugins.description: Send WhatsApp messages from your own number via Meta's official WhatsApp Cloud API. Outbound v1: templates and free-form replies inside the 24-hour window.

plugins.name: obsidian-mcp
plugins.description: Read and search your own Obsidian vault from Claude — your notes never leave your machine. Read-only by default. Packaging of the third-party MIT-licensed MCPVault server by Mauricio Wolff; not a PappCorn-authored connector.

plugins.name: best-practices-git
plugins.description: How a team that works with agents commits and opens pull requests: /commit writes messages that explain why, /git-pr keeps PRs small and can never push to a protected branch, /worktree makes parallel branches the default. Adapts to your repo's existing conventions.

plugins.name: product-team
plugins.description: PappCorn's six-agent INSPIRED product team (product-manager, uiux-designer, coder, qa-tester, debugger, deployer) plus the dev-loop skills (triage, ship-issue, review-loop, issue-planner). Licensed plugin — installation requires granted read access to its repo. Request access: cris@pappcorn.com.
